meta.name: git-rebase-workflow
meta.description: Guide Claude through safe git rebase workflows: interactive rebase, conflict resolution, squash strategies, and force-push safety. Use when the user asks "rebase my branch", "clean up commits", "squash commits before PR", "rebase onto main", "resolve rebase conflicts", or wants help with git history cleanup. 安全的 Git Rebase 工作流指南：交互式变基、冲突解决、 提交压缩策略和安全强制推送。

copy.tagline: 安全地整理 Git 提交历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要变基、压缩提交或解决 Git 冲突。
copy.tagline_en: Safely clean up Git commit history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to rebase, squash commits, or resolve Git conflicts.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你安全地使用 git rebase 操作，包括交互式变基、解决冲突、压缩提交和安全的强制推送。
howto.when: 当你要求“rebase 我的分支”、“清理提交”、“在 PR 前压缩提交”、“rebase 到 main”或“解决 rebase 冲突”时触发。

say.text: 帮我 rebase 我的功能分支到 main。
say.note: Claude 会执行同步和变基步骤。

say.text: 我有 8 个杂乱的提交，帮我清理一下。
say.note: Claude 会启动交互式变基并指导压缩。

say.text: rebase 时出现冲突，怎么解决？
say.note: Claude 会展示冲突文件并指导解决。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through safe git rebase operations, including interactive rebase, conflict resolution, commit squashing, and safe force-pushing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "rebase my branch", "clean up commits", "squash commits before PR", "rebase onto main", or "resolve rebase conflicts".

say_en.text: Help me rebase my feature branch onto main.
say_en.note: Claude will perform sync and rebase steps.

say_en.text: I have 8 messy commits, help me clean them up.
say_en.note: Claude will start interactive rebase and guide squashing.

say_en.text: I have conflicts during rebase, how to resolve?
say_en.note: Claude will show conflicted files and guide resolution.
